review_notes: Issue #3945 reproduces duplicate and conflicting pip constraint files when explicit constraints are combined with generated package constraints, and merged PR #3948 makes explicit constraints take precedence.
Retain pip_install.py as file-level ground truth because the fix spans two existing methods and a new property; documentation, tests, and changelog are excluded.
Issue #5077 reproduces HTTPS-only assert_hostname and assert_fingerprint options leaking into HTTPConnection construction, and merged PR #5102 adds both to SSL_KEYWORDS.
Retain src/urllib3/poolmanager.py as module-level constant ground truth; tests and changelog are excluded.
Issue #87303 reproduces librpm rejecting armored keys without a trailing newline, and merged PR #87304 normalizes the armor before pgpParsePkts.
Retain lib/ansible/modules/rpm_key.py::LibRPM._parse_armor; integration tests and changelog are excluded.
Issue #27216 shows FURB131 incorrectly rewriting dictionary full-slice deletion, and merged PR #27711 restricts the rule to lists.
Retain the Rust rule implementation as file-only ground truth; generated snapshots are excluded.
Issue #34338 reports array-like radius values failing only when radius_neighbors uses multiple jobs, and merged PR #34341 slices radius with the same worker slice as X.
Retain RadiusNeighborsMixin.radius_neighbors; changelog and regression tests are excluded, and unmerged PR #34353 is not a second fix case.
Issue #66517 reproduces OverflowError when convert_dtypes receives integers outside int64 range, and merged PR #66791 keeps object dtype unless a fitting masked integer dtype exists.
Retain pandas/core/dtypes/cast.py::convert_dtypes; tests and whatsnew are excluded, and superseded Issues #66556 and #66596 must not be counted separately.
Issue #32133 reproduces an unbounded allocation in _mark_every_path during extreme zooming with float markevery, and merged PR #32150 avoids the full marker-distance matrix.
Retain lib/matplotlib/lines.py::_mark_every_path; tests are excluded and existing Matplotlib cases use different backend files.
Issue #70822 reports the Microsoft Graph filesystem failing when the UI supplies scopes but not scope, and merged PR #70879 normalizes scope values and always supplies authlib's singular scope.
Retain msgraph.py::get_fs as the entry-point symbol; unit tests are excluded and related Issue #69463 is not the same fix.
Issue #11224 reproduces an uncaught inference error for an uninferable operand in NaN comparison checking, and merged PR #11250 catches astroid.InferenceError in the nested helper.
Retain ComparisonChecker._check_nan_comparison._is_float_nan; changelog and functional tests are excluded.
Issue #71319 reports Keycloak team operations omitting the team-scoped DAG resource, and merged PR #71572 adds Dag:{team} to both permission creation and attachment paths.
Retain _attach_team_permissions as the create-team path symbol while file ground truth covers the second behavior point; tests are excluded.

rejections.reason: PR #4862 fixes three Issues (#4857, #4858, and #4859) in one regex change, so Issue #4858 cannot provide a unique Issue-to-Fix-PR ground-truth pair.
PR #4997 only references and partially advances Issue #3085; later PRs #5007 and #5173 complete and close the broader pkg_resources removal.
